title: Ma / Active Interval

source_refs.author: Japanese aesthetic and performance scholarship
source_refs.title: Ma as interval and relational space

observed_structure: an interval between actions remains perceptually active
absence changes the relation between surrounding events
duration and spacing create pressure without withholding basic causality
cinematic_affordances: cut delayed until the relation changes
cultural_scope: Japanese aesthetic concept; retain provenance and do not claim universal equivalence with generic minimalism
transferable_structure: the interval between present elements becomes an active relational force that changes subsequent action
non_transferable_surface: imitating Japanese architecture, ritual, costume, or framing as aesthetic shorthand
